fnol_text: My name is Amara Sorensen and I live at 175 Linden Drive, Greenville, SC 29659. You can reach me on (555) 354-3527 or amara.sorensen@example.com. We had a cloudburst on 9 February 2026. The drains in the street could not cope and surface water from the road came up the drive and into the ground floor through the front door. Policy HH-2023-00068. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Sorensen on (555) 354-3527 to acknowledge the claim. Amara confirmed the loss date as 9 February 2026.
Site visit to 175 Linden Drive. Neighbour Lucia Delgado was present and confirmed the timeline.
Amara sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
